description: A restorative static stretch using a doorframe or wall corner to open anterior shoulders and counteract rounded upper back posture.
setup: Stand inside an open doorway, bending one or both elbows to 90 degrees and resting forearms against the frame at shoulder height.
steps: Place forearms flat against the door jamb with elbow aligned with chest height.
Step one foot through the doorway while keeping torso tall and core engaged.
Gently shift bodyweight forward until a comfortable opening stretch is felt across chest and front shoulders.
Hold the position steadily while taking deep diaphragmatic breaths.
cues: Breathe deeply into your chest expansion
Keep shoulders relaxed away from ears

mistakes.mistake: Arching lower back to force torso further forward
mistakes.fix: Brace abs to keep ribs down so stretch stays focused in pectoral fibers

mistakes.mistake: Pressing into sharp joint pain at anterior shoulder
mistakes.fix: Adjust elbow height slightly lower or step back slightly until stretch is comfortable

rep_standard: Maintain static hold with stable posture and calm breathing for full assigned duration
